tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.description: Return the current operational status, gate, scheduled departure, delay, departure airport, and aircraft tail number for one specific flight such as AI203. Use this for flight-status questions.

flight_number.description: Airline flight number, for example AI203

tools.name: search_passenger
tools.description: Find a passenger booking by their full name and return booking reference, seat, and destination. Use this for passenger itinerary questions.

tools.name: maintenance_history
tools.description: Return the latest inspection date, total hours flown, and outstanding maintenance issues for one aircraft tail number such as VT-ANX. Use this to assess airworthiness or maintenance risk.

tools.name: find_available_gate
tools.description: Find one currently open gate in a named terminal such as T1 or T2. Use this when an operator needs an unoccupied gate.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Return visibility, wind, temperature, and conditions for an airport code such as DEL. Use this when weather may affect flight operations.

tools.name: lookup_aircraft
tools.description: Return physical dimensions, passenger capacity, and fuel capacity for an aircraft type such as A320. Use this for aircraft specification questions.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a fact for future sessions. Reusing a key replaces its previous value.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search persistent facts by key or value.
